purpose: Validate a quantity-matched pair that holds the physical query environment fixed while changing only the target/action map.

construction.control_target_rule: target 0 iff first two routing bits are equal; target 1 otherwise

matched_quantities: same represented worlds and world identities
same query identities and query count
same full binary query outcome matrix
same exact 50/50 marginal distribution for every query
same target entropy under uniform world prior
same full-vocabulary target information I(T;Q_all)=H(T), because the full vocabulary resolves both targets
same distribution for every subset of cue variables because the full query outcome matrix is identical
exact_control_argument: the first two routing bits resolve equality-versus-inequality target, giving C_A<=2 and C_F<=2
every declared query is exactly balanced with outcome classes k+1,k+1
the control target classes have sizes k+2,k
therefore no single binary query can resolve the control target

full_suite_boundary.relation_to_contrast: none; focused quantity-topology smoke passes on all supported Python versions

claim_boundary: The construction does not hold the full joint distribution P(T,Q_all) fixed; changing the target/action map is exactly the higher-order structural change of interest.
It therefore proves insufficiency of matched environmental cue distribution, target prevalence, target entropy, and total available target information for identifying acquisition topology.
It does not prove that every conceivable numerical summary is blind to topology; a complete action-conditioned cue table can encode the topology.
The ecological interpretation still requires a biologically meaningful acquisition budget or cost.
The exact budget interaction is a guaranteed-resolution contrast, not a prediction that real organisms will show a one-unit behavioral effect.

common_budget_corollary.routeable: adaptive guaranteed; fixed not guaranteed because C_A<=d+1<2^d<=C_F
common_budget_corollary.control: adaptive and fixed both guaranteed because C_A=C_F=2<=d+1
